method_note: Web search and fetched page text only. Shell egress to source hosts was refused (HTTP 403 on CONNECT: gutenberg.org, archive.org, wikisource.org), and the fetch tool returns a model-summarised page, not source bytes, and would not return chant lines verbatim. No source file was downloaded or hashed in this pass and no transcription was compared word for word. A verdict below is a rights/suitability finding, not a transcription check. Update: YT-13 was downloaded as actual HTML, hashed and checked by direct DOM extraction; its publisher licence page was downloaded and checked. Earlier method limits remain historical. Task 04 (26 Oct 2026): shell connections to zenodo.org, archive.org, gutenberg.org, en.wikisource.org, brill.com, letterkunde.africa and doi.org all failed (curl status 000), so again no source bytes could be downloaded or hashed; findings below come from search results and fetched page text only.

equivalence_with_esa.claim: ẹ̀sà and iwì egúngún are two names for one egúngún-cult chant form.
evidence: YT-IWI-01 Adeduntan (2024), Introduction: ẹ̀sà is 'also called iwì'
YT-06 Akinbo et al. (2022), Section 3, p. 2: èsà 'is also known as Ìwí Egúngún'
YT-IWI-02 Fámúlẹ̀, footnote 9: 'Èṣà/iwì egúngún are praise songs or chants of egúngún'
equivalence_with_esa.method_limit: Read through a summarising fetch tool. The shell could not reach the hosts (HTTP 403 on CONNECT), so there are no source bytes, no SHA-256 and no page-image comparison; wording is as returned by that tool. Spelling varies across the sources (ẹ̀sà, èsà, Èṣà; iwì, Ìwí).
equivalence_with_esa.scope: Allows a verified passage that its own source labels ẹ̀sà or iwì egúngún to be taught under the scheme's iwì egúngún label. It does not make a modern composed poem an inherited traditional chant, and it does not turn an oríkì into an iwì text.

genres.coverage_limit: Written study of a modern research-composed oríkì performed in ẹ̀sà style; not inherited-chant study or observed performance. Mixed YO-SL-094 remains partial because Ọya text is unresolved.
